requirements.title: Household policy profiles group devices by intent
requirements.description: The scenario shall support trusted, kids, guest, IoT, and work profiles with per-group DNS policy, filtering strength, schedule, and override behavior.

validation.notes: Verifies household profiles persist intent without claiming live DNS policy apply.

Verifies the profile CLI reaches the shared Connect API contract.
